title: Comfort Club Membership Terms — One Agreement per Customer
content:
**Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements — membership terms, holding limit.**

1. **One agreement.** A customer may hold only one (1) Comfort Club agreement, and that one agreement covers every enrolled system at the customer's single service address, up to the tier's maximum number of systems covered.
2. **No second open agreement.** A new agreement may be enrolled only when the customer has no other Comfort Club agreement in pending, active, past due or lapsed status. This is read from the company's agreement records held under that customer before the enrollment is made; the customer's own account of what they hold does not replace the record.
3. **Lapsed agreements inside grace.** A customer whose agreement is lapsed and still inside its renewal grace period is reinstated rather than enrolled again.
4. **After a cancellation.** A customer whose earlier agreement is cancelled may enroll a new agreement. The new agreement starts its count of consecutive terms again at 1 and carries no locked rate from the old agreement.

### The holding limit at a glance

| Status of the customer's existing Comfort Club agreement | Effect of this clause on enrolling a new agreement |
|---|---|
| Pending | Blocked |
| Active | Blocked |
| Past due | Blocked |
| Lapsed | Blocked; inside the renewal grace period the agreement is reinstated instead |
| Cancelled | Not blocked; the new agreement starts at term count 1 with no locked rate carried over |
| No agreement on record | Not blocked |

"Not blocked" means only that this clause does not stand in the way; the enrollment still has to meet the enrollment eligibility rules for the systems being enrolled.

### Points of judgement
- **One address, several systems.** A furnace and a heat pump at the same service address belong on the same agreement (within the tier's system limit), never on two agreements.
- **Old agreement cancelled years ago.** Starting fresh means the count of consecutive terms restarts at 1; the earlier agreement's terms are not carried into the new one.
